jobs.occupation: Junior Martech Specialist Mobile Apps - English Speaking (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
Über UnsCustomlytics is the leading app marketing consultancy in the DACH region. Our international team of professionals from more than 10 nationalities helps apps succeed and drives the professionalization of the app industry by working with all relevant app companies in the market. Can you imagine a world without apps? Neither can we!

As a Junior MarTech Specialist (Mobile App focus), you will support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of clients’ mobile app marketing and tracking systems. You will work closely with team members to ensure Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as Adjust and AppsFlyer are correctly configured and functioning properly.

You will be onboarded into mobile attribution and tracking systems, quickly gaining hands-on experience with troubleshooting issues and helping ensure that tracking, event collection, and campaign data are correctly recorded across advertising platforms. You will also help maintain mobile app data feeds and marketing datasets, ensuring data quality and supporting updates under guidance from senior colleagues.

In addition, you will contribute to reporting and dashboard creation by preparing data and supporting the build of simple visualizations that help teams understand campaign performance and user acquisition. You will support internal teams and clients such as Rewe, Audible, and Telekom by assisting in maintaining reliable tracking setups and helping resolve basic data or integration issues.
Deine Aufgaben
• Support the setup and maintenance of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as Adjust and AppsFlyer, helping ensure accurate tracking and attribution functionality.
• Assist in identifying and troubleshooting basic tracking or event issues in mobile app campaigns.
• Help maintain and update clients’ product feeds and marketing datasets, ensuring data is correctly structured and validated.
• Support the connection of marketing tools and data sources to improve visibility of campaign performance. building and updating dashboards and visualizations in tools such as Clarisights, Adverity, and Google Sheets.
• Work with senior team members and developers to understand technical requirements and support implementation tasks.
• Monitor tracking setups and reporting flows to help ensure data accuracy and reliability.

You don’t have experience in all those tasks? No worries! We will be happy to onboard you on all of our processes and provide you with the opportunity to quickly learn and experience Martech hands on!

Dein Profil
• Background: Background in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related discipline, with an interest in marketing data, tracking systems, and campaign attribution.
• Product Feeds: Basic understanding of product feed structures; experience with tools like ProductsUp is a plus.
• Mobile Measurement Partners: Introductory knowledge of MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer); willingness to learn troubleshooting and tracking fundamentals.
• Advertising Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, or TikTok (hands-on experience is a plus).
• Data & Reporting: experience working with Excel or Google Sheets; understanding of simple data handling and reporting.
• Automation & AI Tools: Interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Make.com, or Google Sheets automation; no advanced experience required.
• Analytical Mindset : Curious and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn how data supports marketing decisions.
• Communication & Collaboration: Able to communicate clearly, ask questions, and work effectively within a team.
• Working Style: Structured, proactive, and eager to develop technical and analytical skills.
• Languages : Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus but not required.

Dein Extra
• Your Growth & Development: Access to certifications, 360° feedback, and salary progression. Real opportunities to grow together with your team and the company.
• Remote Work: Work remotely for up to 90 days per year; anywhere in Germany or internationally.
• Office Vibes in Friedrichshain: Snacks, drinks, height-adjustable desks, and focus rooms for deep, concentrated work.
• Germany Ticket: We cover most of your public transport costs: good for the planet and your wallet.
• Top-Notch Equipment: MacBook, noise-cancelling headphones, and all the tools you need to succeed.
• Core Working Hours: Making collaboration easy and your schedule steady.
• Corporate Benefits: Exclusive deals with popular online brands.
• Support for Parents: Extra support for parents with preschool-aged children.
• Team Culture & Events: From monthly activities to our big annual meetup in Berlin, we create space to celebrate, connect, and grow as a team.
• German Language Courses : We support you with professional online German classes.
• Referral Bonus: Whether new teammates or new clients, your recommendations pay off.

We're committed to diversity and equal opportunity for all, welcoming individuals of any gender, age, origin, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. If you're creative, problem-solving, and passionate about app marketing, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be yourself in an atmosphere where diversity is celebrated and embraced.

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of over 100,000 colleagues provides an outstanding mix of brand new technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services across our top-tier brands like Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon, and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information:

Phadia is the leading supplier of fully automatic blood analysis systems for allergy and auto-immune diseases. With our innovative products, we set standards worldwide and assist clinicians in providing fast and reliable diagnoses, thus helping patients at an early stage. Phadia GmbH in Freiburg is the German subsidiary of the Immunodiagnostics division of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a global company that develops, manufactures and distributes in vitro diagnostics in the field of allergy and autoimmune diagnostics. Our customers expect a consistently reliable and high standard of quality from our products, which we ensure through innovative biochemical and medical technology solutions as well as highly qualified and motivated employees.

A Day in the Life:

- Provide scientific support for the quality control and quality assurance of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products for autoimmune diseases
- Perform quality control testing of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), antigens, raw materials, and reagents as part of routine production and development projects using advanced analytical techniques
- Provide technical guidance and supervision to technical staff
- Participate in projects related to the development and implementation of new products and analytical instruments, including LIMS integration
- Support the transfer of products and test methods from development into routine operations, working closely with colleagues in R&D and Production
- Contribute to projects focused on product lifecycle management and process optimization, including manufacturing and testing procedures as well as production equipment
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives
- Investigate and resolve deviations and customer complaints, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and continuous improvement measures
- Work with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, support regulatory audits, and implement process improvements
- Prepare and review study reports and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in compliance with applicable ISO and GMP requirements

Keys to Success:

- Advanced degree plus some years of experience, or Bachelor's degree plus many years of experience in GMP/GLP regulated laboratory environment
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology or related scientific field
- Extensive knowledge in development, production or quality control of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs)
- Strong understanding of regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, ISO, ICH guidelines)
- Experience with method validation, method transfer, and verification activities
- Proficiency in data analysis, trending, and statistical evaluation
- Demonstrated expertise in laboratory documentation and GMP compliance
- Strong technical writing skills for SOPs, protocols, and investigation reports
- Experience with LIMS and quality management systems
- Proven ability to lead investigations and implement corrective actions
- Excellent project management and organizational skills
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to mentor staff
- Ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
- Good to excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English

What we offer:

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organisation
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement and innovation

If you are interested, please apply online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date and salary expectations.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Job description

In order to support our Data Processing & Analytics Team as a Backend and DevOps Engineer, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Junior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)

In this role, you will help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and backend services powering our data analytics platform. You’ll sit at the intersection of backend software development and modern platform operations (DevOps), working closely with data engineers and analysts to ensure our analytics ecosystem is performant, reliable, and observable.

If you enjoy automating deployments, and managing modern data stores in containerized environments, this is a great opportunity to jumpstart your career.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. - Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- DevOps Engineering: Contribute to the development and maintenance using Ansible, Gitlab-CI, Helm etc.

- Observability & Monitoring: Set up and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting configurations using Prometheus and Grafana to ensure platform uptime and health.
- Version Control & Shell Automation: Use Git for version control and workflow management, and write basic Unix shell scripts (Bash) for automation and routine system tasks.
- Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, document setup procedures, and collaborate with senior platform engineers to troubleshoot infrastructure issues.

- An academic degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
- Technical competencies
- Backend Programming: Foundational programming skills in at least one or two core languages used across our ecosystem (Go, Python, Java, or Kotlin).
- Knowledge of DevOps : Ansible, Terraform, Gitlab-CI, Helm, OCI, ArgoCD.
- Version Control: Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, pull requests, versioning workflows).
- Linux / Unix Basics: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems and comfort navigating the CLI or writing basic shell scripts.
- Problem-Solving Mindset: Eager to learn modern infrastructure practices and systematically debug issues across backend code and data pipelines.

- Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.
You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.
Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.
You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.
Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth
* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment
* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements
* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success
* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy future

What You Bring

* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications
* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication
* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments
* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- You will characterize and investigate CHO host cell proteins, with a particular focus on critical and difficult-to-remove species that may affect downstream processing and product stability.
- Using advanced mass spectrometry-based approaches, you will identify, quantify, and profile host cell proteins and support impurity risk assessment through data-driven analyses.
- You will establish, optimize, and apply analytical and functional assays to evaluate host cell protein behavior at trace levels throughout different purification stages.
- Through recombinant protein expression strategies, you will enable the in-depth characterization of selected host cell proteins under controlled experimental conditions.
- In close collaboration with downstream process development and analytics, you will investigate interactions between host cell proteins and therapeutic proteins and translate findings into risk mitigation strategies.
- As principal investigator for research and technology projects, you will lead scientific studies, oversee project execution and data interpretation, supervise students and technical staff, and communicate results effectively to stakeholders and management.

Requirements

- PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Biology, or a related scientific discipline
- Strong expertise in protein biochemistry and molecular characterization, ideally including experience with host cell proteins (HCPs)
- Hands-on experience with mass spectrometry-based protein identification and quantification methods, preferably with a focus on host cell protein analysis
- Experience in MS data processing and analysis using bioinformatics tools, including both raw and processed datasets; knowledge of recombinant protein expression and purification is highly desirable
- Solid understanding of downstream processing concepts, chromatography principles, and data-driven experimental design and quantitative data analysis
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, supported by a strong scientific publication record and excellent English communication, scientific writing, and documentation skills

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science (Max Planck Gesellschaft, MPG) is a self-governing scientific organization funded by the Federal and State Governments. It conducts basic research in the fields of natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences in 85 institutes and research units in Germany and abroad.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

Scientific Scouting Officer (all genders) –

80% part‑time initially, with a potential full‑time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)

to start as early as possible.

The Section includes a range of disciplines, notably the History of Art, Anthropology, Demography, Economics, the History of Science, Law, Neurosciences, Political Sciences, Psychology, and Sociology.

Your responsibilities

- Proactive and systematic identification of outstanding scientists to support the Human Sciences Section and its Core and Appointment Commissions
- Building and analyzing candidate pools, generating appropriate statistics
- Using various talent acquisition tools, including but not limited to internet sourcing, data mining, social media, networking at national and international conferences, as well as other creative methods to identify outstanding candidates
- Analyzing candidate lists generated through nomination calls
- Implementing, maintaining and further developing candidate databases together with the two Scouting Officers of the other section
- Attending international conferences, participating in public outreach to promote the MPG
- Complementing the current scouting team and actively participating in constantly developing the team’s scouting concept, tackling human sciences-oriented as well as interdisciplinary scouting projects

Your profile

- Doctoral degree in one of the scientific disciplines of the Human Sciences Section and several years of postdoctoral experience
- Education and/or postdoctoral research abroad, ideally for several years
- In-depth knowledge of the German and international research landscape (including organizational and research-specific framework conditions)
- Proven scientific track record and demonstrated knowledge of the respective scientific community
- General interest in a broad range of scientific subjects covered in the Human Sciences Section and ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new areas of research
- Solution-oriented, service-driven, creative and open-minded working style
- Excellent proficiency in English (written and spoken, level C1–C2) and good proficiency in German (minimum level B2)
- Excellent interpersonal communication and networking skills, in order to interact with and coordinate partners with diverse professional and multicultural backgrounds
- Experience in working with AI applications or a willingness to learn how to use such systems
- Willingness to adopt flexible working hours, as well as taking part in regular business travel in Germany and abroad
- Experience in scouting/recruiting scientists would be desirable

Our offer

- You will gain fascinating insights into the outstanding research at our Max Planck Institutes.
- You will help to identify the next generation of outstanding scientists for the MPG by directly interacting with its leadership and directors.
- As a member of the Section Office, you will cooperate with the department "Institutes" at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG.
- You will obtain an excellent overview of the entire spectrum of scientific administration and the structure of the German research landscape.

We are offering a payment up to salary level 14 of the collective wage agreement for the civil service (TVöD Bund) as well as various benefits.
This position is permanent and 80% part-time initially, with a potential full-time transition effective 1 January 2029. You will be based at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG, located in the centre of Munich.

We offer a supportive work environment with flexible schedules, remote work options, and work-life balance. We invest in your professional growth through personalized development opportunities, health promotion programmes, and a company pension plan. Additional benefits include discounted public transportation passes and full access to standard public sector social benefits.

The Max Planck Society has set a goal of employing more people with severe disabilities. Applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society is committed to gender equality and diversity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
